adaptation.name: pvsg_conv_k5_l3
adaptation.status: GT-track design adaptation, not end-to-end benchmark reproduction
changes: GT masks, labels, track IDs and frozen CLIP instead of predicted IPS/VPS object-query tubes
M3 MLP node encoder and 128-D pair projection before Conv
Framewise shared 57-label head, masked BCE and fixed M1 interval decoder instead of released two heads and pairing losses
All co-visible ordered pairs; split visibility gaps; padding masked after every Conv
Frozen M2 287/51/62 internal split and target adaptation; raw annotation untouched
adaptation.comparison: Only compare to M3 under same GT-track protocol. RF=13 vs ST-GAT RF=5; use mlp_conv_k3_l2 as optional RF control.
